snippet.description:

Turn it on: File, Options and settings, Options, Preview features, tick the Gantt preview, then restart Power BI Desktop.
Visualizations pane: pick the Gantt visual. Add the task name, then Start and End. Leave End blank and that row becomes a milestone.
Add a percent complete measure to show progress, group tasks by up to 3 category levels, and readers can zoom into a date window. Up to 1,000 rows.
Preview features can change before release. Sources: Power BI October 2026 Feature Summary and Microsoft Learn (Gantt visual in Power BI, preview). Numbers are illustrative.

Ada ayah yang jarang menunjukkan perasaan. Tetapi apabila melihat anak sendiri berdiri di atas pentas, lain rasanya.
ㅤ
Itulah antara detik yang dikongsikan oleh pasangan ibu ayah dari Brainy Bunch Alisa Man semasa Year End Concert 2026.
ㅤ
Melihat anak berani membuat persembahan di hadapan ramai orang sudah cukup menggembirakan mereka.
ㅤ
Lebih-lebih lagi apabila mengenangkan bagaimana anak mereka berkembang sejak mula memasuki Brainy Bunch.
ㅤ
Antara perubahan yang paling ketara ialah kemahiran komunikasi.
ㅤ
Anak mereka kini semakin baik berkomunikasi dalam English dan Bahasa Melayu.
ㅤ
Perkembangan seperti ini mungkin berlaku sedikit demi sedikit.
ㅤ
Daripada anak yang masih memerlukan bantuan untuk menyampaikan sesuatu, sehinggalah semakin yakin menggunakan bahasa untuk berkomunikasi dengan orang di sekeliling.
ㅤ
Di Brainy Bunch, kami mahu anak bukan sekadar mengenali huruf, nombor dan perkataan.
ㅤ
Kami juga mahu mereka berani mencuba, menyampaikan pendapat dan berinteraksi dengan orang lain.
ㅤ
Sebab kemahiran komunikasi bukan hanya digunakan ketika belajar di dalam kelas.
ㅤ

snippet.description:

밴스 부통령이 이란 전쟁을 패배 원인으로 지목하며 트럼프 대통령과 엇갈린 입장을 드러낸 가운데, 충성파 이탈 가능성과 젊은 지지층의 반발까지 제기되고 있습니다.

트럼프·밴스 갈등설과 공화당 내부 분열, 미국 중간선거 참패 및 이란 전쟁 관련 주요 뉴스를 모아서 전해드립니다.

snippet.title: Is the world preparing for the apocalypse? | BBC News
snippet.description:
Preppers have long been planning for the worst-case scenario. Are governments now doing the same?  

The UK government has launched a national “Be Ready” campaign, urging people to keep enough food, water and medicine at home to prepare for three days of disruption.

Other European countries have similar policies. But for preppers, whose mission it is to ready themselves for a future disaster, this is old news. Have the preppers been vindicated? And what exactly are we prepping for?

Tristan Redman speaks to Lucy Easthope about her role as a disaster planning expert and Gabriel Gatehouse joins us in the studio to talk about what he's learnt from interviewing British preppers. 

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
